lede: TT Motorsport @ Jurong is a car workshop in Toh Guan Road East and Enterprise Hub. Its own website lists service and maintenance, spray painting and panel beating, transmission and engine overhaul and accident claim repair.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention wheel bearing and shock absorber replacement, accurate diagnosis of overheating and coolant leaks, major engine work such as camshaft and valves, and help arranging a tow truck.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, ttmotorsport.sg.
makes_note: Named on its own website. Ask the workshop about other makes.
good_to_know: Enquiries by WhatsApp, according to its website
